Notes:
- Critical CSS (~2.5 KB: tokens, base type, header/nav, hero, buttons, skip link) is inlined in `<head>`; the full stylesheet and Google Fonts CSS load asynchronously via the `media="print"` swap pattern with `<noscript>` fallbacks, plus `rel="preload"` on the main stylesheet.
- `main.js` carries `defer` (progressive enhancement only; site fully works without JS).
- **Images: the site currently ships zero `<img>` elements** (all visuals are CSS). `loading="lazy"` + explicit `width`/`height` is therefore vacuously satisfied; **policy for future images:** every below-fold `<img>` must carry `loading="lazy"`, `decoding="async"` and explicit `width`/`height` to reserve layout space.
